# Fiduciary Compliance Checker Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when validating fiduciary compliance for investment advisors including SEC/state RIA requirements, ERISA fiduciary rules, trust fiduciary duties, and documentation of fiduciary care standard.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [fiduciary-compliance-checker-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
fiduciary-compliance-checker-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@fiduciary-compliance-checker` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Validate SEC registered investment advisor fiduciary duty compliance
- Assess ERISA 3(21) and 3(38) fiduciary obligations for plan advisory services
- Review trust administration for Prudent Investor Rule and duty of loyalty compliance
- Check fee disclosure and transparency per fiduciary requirements

## Industry Standards Applied

- **Investment Advisers Act of 1940**: SEC fiduciary duty obligations for registered investment advisors
- **ERISA Sections 3(21), 3(38), 404(a)**: Fiduciary duties for retirement plan investment advisors
- **Uniform Prudent Investor Act**: Trust fiduciary standard for investment management
